title: records resolutions file
description: The owner's answers to the ambiguous lines of one legacy document (records E12 contract section 11.5). When an import stops, its exit-5 report lists every ambiguous line with its number, its raw text, the reason, and the candidate finding IDs; this file answers them. Each answer carries `raw`, the line's text as it was when the answer was given, so that section 11.5's rule "a resolution that names a line whose raw text has changed is rejected" is checkable from the file alone. An answer that names a line the import did not stop on, a line whose raw text no longer matches, a finding the document does not raise, or an answer shape the question cannot take, is rejected (exit 4) and nothing is written.

answered_by.description: who answered; the owner, or a session acting on the owner's word

answered_on.description: the date the answers were given; it becomes the `at` of every resolution_applied event

doc.description: optional: the ledger document these answers are for, workspace-relative. The importer refuses a file that names another document.

note.description: optional free text; the component reads nothing from it

line.description: the 1-based line of the legacy document

raw.description: the line exactly as the exit-5 report gave it

finding.description: this line belongs to that finding

new_finding.description: this line raises a finding of its own

skip.description: record the line as legacy_unparsed and move on

why.description: required with skip; it becomes the legacy_unparsed reason

answer.description: exactly one of finding, new_finding, or skip; skip carries its reason
